title: Robot walk
prompt: A robot starts at (0, 0) facing north and executes a list of commands: 0 = move forward one step, 1 = turn left 90 degrees, 2 = turn right 90 degrees (only these codes appear). Facing north a step adds 1 to y, east adds 1 to x, south subtracts 1 from y, west subtracts 1 from x; turning left from north faces west, turning right from north faces east. Return pair(pair(x, y), n) where (x, y) is the final position and n is the number of commands after which the robot is at (0, 0) (check after every command, including turns; the starting position before any command does not count). For the empty list return pair(pair(0, 0), 0).
